Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make a Prime Meat and Rice Bowl by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Prime Meat]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s. Since these bowls contain high-quality [[Meat]], they are considered to be a serious [[Meal]]. Extra [[Ingredient]]s can be added to Prime Meat and Rice Bowls, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. They will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]] by eating these bowls. * '''Enduring Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Consuming them will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. Link can refill part of his [[Stamina Wheel]] by eating these. * '''Hasty Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. These bowls can be eaten to increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Spicy Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when they're eaten. * '''Tough Prime Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This bowl is loaded with high-quality meat. Your hunt for a serious meal ends here.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients.
